description: Assign all contacts in the range to the group s1 (in, optionally, slot s2 ). Contacts on hidden blocks are not included.

keywords.name: remove
keywords.description: Remove the group name (in the given slot) from entities in the range. (Listed by 3DEC 9.7.47; not on the manual page.)

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Assign the group name in a named slot. (Listed by 3DEC 9.7.47; not on the manual page.)
